rebuild_requirements: Use the approved image as the shape and appearance reference, not a generic parametric doll with recolored hair.
Match head/body proportions, facial silhouette, eye shape, expression, layered hair volume and outfit silhouette before fine detail.
Preserve characteristic clothing construction, trim, buckles, shoes, bags and props individually for all ten characters.
All ten playable units must be truly volumetric and viewable through camera orbit: front, three-quarter, both sides, back, above and below.
Inspect hidden surfaces separately; unseen surfaces are inferred and cannot be claimed identical to a single-view reference.
Do not use generated still images, video frames, sprites or billboards as evidence of a completed real 3D model.
Do not mark visually approved based only on GLB validity, polygon counts, skeletons, animation names or browser functional tests.
Validate one reference-matched character before applying a reconstruction process to the other nine.
Do not replace online-game assets with rejected sculpts. Integrate accepted models only after materials, animation deformation and board-scale visibility are tested.
Capture an actual 360-degree turntable, board-view screenshot, and Idle/Walk/action footage from the mesh, not an image-to-video approximation.
Record the exact GLB SHA-256 in evidence and eventual game integration so a different model cannot silently substitute for the reviewed one.
A standalone inspection viewer is not proof of live-game integration. Test the board and character selector with the same accepted asset.
